description: Required Q4 coverage: missed cross-sell. The customer twice signals a second vehicle and an expansion plan; the agent stays on script and never responds to either. The nudge must fire DURING the call, while there is still time to act.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Good afternoon, this is Anaya from the business loans team. Just so you know, I'm an AI assistant, not a human agent, and this call is recorded for quality purposes. Is this a good time?

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Thank you. Could you tell me the name of your business and how long it has been running?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: It's Chauhan Logistics, running about six years now. Actually we just bought a second truck last month, and we're planning another vehicle next quarter.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Understood. And what was your turnover in the last financial year?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: About sixty seven lakhs. The second vehicle is really stretching our working capital, that's the whole problem.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Right. And how much were you looking to borrow?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Around eighteen lakhs. We also want to expand to a new depot if things go well.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Noted. Is the business GST registered?

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Thank you. I'll pass this to a credit officer for review and someone will call you back. Thanks for your time.
